titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Edukacja — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: School & Education — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Edukacja: szkoła, przedmioty, oceny, egzaminy. Wklejasz listę w Bomb Defusal, fiszki albo Live Quiz.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Education module: school life, subjects, marks, exams. Paste into Bomb, Flashcards or Live Quiz.

items.definitionEn: a list of lessons and times for each day
items.example: Check the timetable — maths is first on Monday.

items.definitionEn: the person in charge of a school
items.example: The headteacher spoke to all students in the hall.

items.definitionEn: the teacher responsible for one class
items.example: Tell your form tutor if you feel ill.

items.definitionEn: the room at school where you eat lunch
items.example: The canteen serves soup and a hot main dish.

items.definitionEn: an outdoor area where students play at break
items.example: We play basketball in the playground after lunch.

items.definitionEn: work teachers give you to do at home
items.example: I have to finish my homework before dinner.

items.definitionEn: a number or letter that shows how good your work is
items.example: She got a good mark in the geography project.

items.definitionEn: to not get the result you need in a test
items.example: He failed the test because he did not study.

items.definitionEn: to succeed in a test or exam
items.example: You need fifty percent to pass.

items.definitionEn: to study again before a test
items.example: She revised for the exam all weekend.

items.definitionEn: to break the rules to get a better result
items.example: If you cheat, the teacher will take your paper away.

items.definitionEn: a short rest between lessons
items.example: We eat a snack at break time.

items.definitionEn: one of the parts of the school year
items.example: The autumn term ends in December.

items.definitionEn: special clothes that all students must wear
items.example: You don't have to wear a uniform at this school.

items.definitionEn: required; you have no choice
items.example: Maths is a compulsory subject until the end of year eight.

items.definitionEn: you can choose to do it or not
items.example: Drama is optional in our school.

items.definitionEn: an area of study such as history or English
items.example: My favourite subject is biology.

items.definitionEn: lessons about nature, physics or chemistry
items.example: We did an experiment in science today.

items.definitionEn: to sit a formal test
items.example: Students take an exam at the end of year eight.

items.definitionEn: to give finished work to the teacher
items.example: Hand in your essays on Friday.

items.definitionEn: a visit organised by the school
items.example: Our class is going on a school trip next Monday.

items.definitionEn: a small cupboard at school for your bag and books
items.example: Keep your phone in your locker during lessons.

items.definitionEn: a board the teacher writes on with a marker
items.example: Copy the date from the whiteboard.

items.definitionEn: to put your arm up if you want to speak
items.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

items.definitionEn: time you must stay after school as a punishment
items.example: He got detention for being late three times.

items.definitionEn: to not go to lessons without permission
items.example: If you skip classes, your parents will be called.

items.definitionEn: a student in the same class as you
items.example: Ask a classmate if you missed the notes.

items.definitionEn: the room where teachers rest and prepare
items.example: Knock before you enter the staff room.

items.definitionEn: a place with books you can borrow
items.example: The library is on the second floor.

items.definitionEn: to take something for a short time and then return it
items.example: Can I borrow your blue pen for a moment?

items.definitionEn: school for younger children
items.example: She started primary school at the age of five.

items.definitionEn: school for older children after primary
items.example: In Britain, secondary school usually starts at eleven.

items.definitionEn: a longer piece of work, often in a group
items.example: We are doing a project in small groups.

items.definitionEn: to go regularly to school or a lesson
items.example: You must attend all lessons unless you are ill.

items.definitionEn: to give all your attention to something
items.example: It is hard to concentrate when the class is noisy.

items.definitionEn: to memorise something so you can say it without looking
items.example: The teacher asked us to learn by heart a short poem.
